# xfo-miner v1.0.9

This release promotes the latest miner protocol compatibility fixes for Wallet Recovery, Pool JSON-RPC message dispatch, dictionary-backed candidate slicing, and Hashcat probe classification.

## Highlights

- Adds explicit Wallet Recovery result typing so cracked wallet-recovery jobs report `result_kind=wallet_result` back to the Pool while preserving `parent_job_id`.
- Accepts Pool JSON-RPC-style WebSocket messages that carry `method` plus `params`, allowing capability probes to dispatch through the same miner callback path as legacy typed envelopes.
- Improves dictionary cache behavior for large standard dictionaries: the default download timeout is now 15 minutes and cache-stage diagnostics are emitted only through miner debug logging.
- Allows executable `dictionary_slice` work to run without a hash target file when the dictionary runtime path is the authoritative materialized input.
- Treats Hashcat probe runs that complete as exhausted/no-match as capability-supported instead of runtime-unsupported.

## Scope

### Wallet Recovery result protocol

- `internal/pool/protocol.go` adds `ResultMessage.ResultKind`, `JobGPUMessage.TaskType`, and `JobGPUMessage.VerificationType`.
- `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go` identifies wallet-recovery jobs from `task_type=wallet_recovery` or a `verification_type` prefix and sets `result_kind=wallet_result` for cracked results before sending them to Pool.
- `internal/scheduler/scheduler_test.go` verifies cracked Wallet Recovery results carry `wallet_result` and keep their `parent_job_id`.

### Pool message compatibility

- `internal/pool/client.go` now dispatches both legacy `type` envelopes and JSON-RPC-style `method` / `params` envelopes.
- `internal/pool/client_test.go` covers JSON-RPC capability probe dispatch into the existing callback contract.

### Dictionary-backed Wallet Recovery execution

- `internal/scheduler/dictionary_cache.go` restores a 15-minute default HTTP timeout for large dictionary downloads and gates detailed cache stage events behind the existing debug log facility.
- `internal/scheduler/dictionary_contract.go` centralizes `dictionary_slice` contract detection.
- `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go` permits dictionary-slice jobs with an empty target when dictionary materialization supplies the runtime input.
- `internal/scheduler/dictionary_cache_test.go` and `internal/scheduler/scheduler_test.go` cover timeout, debug-gated diagnostics, and empty-target dictionary-slice execution.

### Hashcat probe classification

- `internal/scheduler/hashcat.go` and `internal/scheduler/hashcat_evidence.go` now classify completed exhausted/no-match probe output as supported capability evidence.
- `internal/scheduler/hashcat_probe_test.go` covers the completed no-match probe path.

## Validation

- Verified with:
  - `go test ./internal/pool ./internal/scheduler`
  - `go test ./...`

## Operator notes

- Existing miner configs continue to work.
- Wallet Recovery result submissions now include an explicit result kind for Pool-side owner-safe review/finalization flows.
- Dictionary cache diagnostics remain quiet unless miner debug logging is enabled.
